title: Specified derived operations and mate on strict pro-etale module towers
statement: Let $X',X,Y',Y$ be schemes, with morphisms $g':X'\to X$, $f':X'\to Y'$, $f:X\to Y$, $g:Y'\to Y$ and a chosen cartesian square $\square$ [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]. Fix a compatible ringed pro-etale square [def-weil-pbc-four-corners]: ring sheaves $R_T$ on the small pro-etale sites at its four corners and specified isomorphisms $c_u:u^{-1}R_V\simeq R_U$ for each edge $u:U\to V$, satisfying the coefficient square equation. Define $\operatorname{Tow}(T,R_T)=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbb N^{\mathrm{op}},\operatorname{Mod}(R_T))$, with $\operatorname{op}(n)$ representing positive level $n+1$ [def-weil-inverse-system]. Let $L_u$ and $R_u$ be termwise ordinary module pullback and direct image with the normalized module adjunction [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Define derived strict-tower pullback by exact descent of $L_u$ and derived strict-tower direct image as the total right derived functor of $R_u$ in the standard derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], using the strict tower Grothendieck and K-injective realization of [prop-weil-pbc-rlim-functoriality]. Their adjunction is obtained by deriving that specified termwise module adjunction. Define $\theta_\square:L_{f'}L_g\simeq L_{g'}L_f$ by the termwise canonical ordinary pullback composition [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition], transported along the given scheme and coefficient square equations and descended to the derived category. Define strict ringed exchange to be its adjunction mate for these specified derived adjunctions [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]. For every commutative ring $A$ in the sheaf-value universe, the constant specialization uses the existing constant ring sheaf $\underline A_T$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] and the canonical constant-section inverse-image comparison, without a finiteness assumption on $A$.

source.place: First two proof sentences; strict normalization supplement, paragraph 2; Stacks 07A7 and 0D6D

proof.text: For arbitrary constant rings, use the constant-sheaf adjunction at a terminal pro-etale object and its base change. The composite of that adjunction with the specified inverse-image adjunction has the same right adjoint as the constant-sheaf adjunction on the source. Its left-adjoint uniqueness isomorphism equals the specified constant-section comparison: transpose it through both adjunctions and the sheafification adjunction, where it is the identity on constant sections. Hence the specified comparison is invertible.

The identified-coefficient module pullback preserves finite limits and finite colimits by proEtaleRingModuleOperations_properties. Mathlib whiskeringRight_preservesLimitsOfShape and whiskeringRight_preservesColimitsOfShape transfer this to strict towers, since finite (co)limits of diagrams are pointwise.

Extract only the ordinary direct-image comparison d and its sectionwise fibre-product-pasting equation from proEtaleRingDerivedPullbackComposition. Apply the inverse of conjugateIsoEquiv for the specified canonical module adjunctions to d. The equivalence right-inverse law gives the required normalization immediately. If another pullback comparison satisfies it, its conjugate agrees with d on every module, test object and section; extensionality of module sheaf morphisms, natural transformations and isomorphisms identifies the conjugates. Injectivity of conjugateIsoEquiv gives uniqueness. The existential auxiliary adjunctions and derived/K-flat comparison are not needed.

Use Sigma.ext with the reverse commutativity equation of the chosen scheme square and the reverse heterogeneous coefficient coherence field. This identifies the two dependent pairs of composite maps and coefficient identifications. Compose ordinary pullback comparisons, whisker termwise, descend by mapDerivedCategory, and take the specified derived adjunction mate, as in the existing definitions.
